restrictions: Exactly 64-byte messages with standard SHA3 suffix 0x06, zero IV, rate 1088, capacity 512, prefix rounds 0 through 5 and all 256 digest bits.
One batch of 2^128 iid messages drawn using 2^129 independent uniform 256-bit random-word primitives; repeated inputs are retained and charged.
256-message bit slicing, three exact charged 256-by-256 transposes, fixed-register Boolean round circuit, full-digest stable radix sorting and final independent verification.

First-round padding constants remove Boolean operations only; all original destination-placement caps remain charged. First round costs at most 15558 operations and is charged 16000; four middle rounds each cost at most 17728 and are charged 18000; final four-lane digest projection costs at most 5824 and is charged 7000.
W <= 759.09375*n + 48*2^64 + 2^24 + 200, T <= W/1626 + 2 < 2^126.902. Memory is below 2^136 bytes. No heuristic, full-scale execution or practical hash break is claimed.
The bit-sliced baseline is credited to may93182 (11c46f4); the final-round projection to ercumentyildirim (c7fa1a5). Both are credited as coauthors for unpromoted work.
The isolated declared experiment checks deterministic implementation equivalence only, returns no collision witnesses and supplies no statistical attack-success claim.
